relations.subject: n1ql:system-indexes-catalog
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - this is a straightforward single-privilege-gates-single-resource-visibility check, the same shape `requiresPrivilege` was promoted for on server/. Unlike the CREATE/DROP/GRANT/REVOKE family on this batch, there is no management-plane role involved here, so no need to mint `requiresCapellaRole`.
relations.evidence: Similarly, users must have SELECT permission on the target of an index to be able to view that index in the system catalog.

cross_product_finding: Two sub-sections of this page ('Query Groups' and 'Query Bucket Information', covering system:group_info and system:bucket_info) are labeled with the badge 'Couchbase Server 8.0' even though this page is served under cloud/ (Capella), and per the registry Capella has no discrete version numbers at all ('Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)'). Evidence: the literal text 'Couchbase Server 8.0' appears immediately before 'You can query group information using the system:group_info keyspace' and again before the system:bucket_info section. Per the registry's explicit guidance, this is flagged here rather than mapped onto `version:server-7.0`/`version:server-6.5` or any new Capella version concept - the content is very likely shared/reused verbatim from the server/ docs module (note the editUrl targets a 'capella' branch of the same docs-devex repo used for server content) and the version badge was probably carried over unintentionally, rather than reflecting a real Capella feature-availability gate. Worth a docs-accuracy look independent of the ontology work.
